args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production
args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to address unhealthy v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18). Recording the change per runbook.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I completed:

1. **Deployed hotfix v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The deploy rolled out successfully, replacing the unhealthy v2.3.1 (which had an 18% error rate).

Note: v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, so per policy this deploy required change-manager approval and was routed accordingly before executing.
